The Port of Savannah’s container docks are humming, while Brunswick’s auto terminals are taking a hit. It’s a tale of two ports, one booming, one bracing.
The numbers tell the story. Savannah moved 5.7 million containers in fiscal 2025, up 8.6% from the year before — the second-busiest year in port history. Since 2016, its traffic has grown at a 4.5% annual clip, outpacing the national port average of 2.7%.

The Associated Press added that retailers “scrambled to stock up,” creating an artificial wave of imports.
